disclosure: Some US product links are affiliate links. When you open a link marked Affiliate link, Select Your Sauna may receive a commission from a qualifying action. The merchant's price does not change.

principles.title: Clear labeling
principles.copy: Affiliate links are marked next to the affected merchant offer before the visitor leaves Select Your Sauna.

principles.title: Independent comparisons
principles.copy: Product inclusion, technical facts, filters and ordering are based on documented records, not commission rates.

principles.title: Exact offer review
principles.copy: Each active link is checked against the approved program, merchant, configuration, destination and current offer record.
